proposals.evidence: DEDR4992 explicitly gives Tamil muḻu/muḻucu/muḻutu whole/all and Malayalam muḻuvan entire. These southern survey muḷu-/muru-/muyu-/musu-/mucu- forms retain that whole/entire family and its ordinary nominal endings, preserving source reflexes of the medial liquid. The explicitly questioned Gondi comparison is not used. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
